title: Eskalator Blok M
subject: a woman late every morning who runs up the left side of the long escalator at Blok M MRT station while the same man in a grey jacket always steps aside for her, until one day he runs beside her
caption: Indonesian liquid drum and bass, Bali festival-scene sound. Rolling two-step breakbeat with crisp ghost snares, deep round sub bass, warm Rhodes electric piano chords, soft string pad, short plucked guitar figure. Polished spacious mix with steady forward motion. Light breathy female vocal, high register, quick conversational phrasing over the half-time feel. 174 BPM, F# minor. Mood of a rushing commute with a small crush in it. No dubstep wobble, no trap drums, no autotune, no big-room EDM drop, no rap verse.
lyrics:
[Intro - Rhodes chords, rolling breakbeat]
[Verse 1]
Jam tujuh lewat delapan
Kartu kutempel, pintu terbuka
Eskalator panjang di depan
Ambil kiri, aku berlari
[Pre-Chorus]
Jaket abu-abu di anak tangga
Dia menepi, selalu sama
[Chorus]
Permisi, permisi, makasih ya
Napasku habis di tengah jalan
Permisi, permisi, besok lagi
Aku telat, kamu yang sabar
[Verse 2]
Hari Senin aku lebih telat
Dia nggak menepi, aku kaget
Dia senyum, terus ikut lari
Dua orang di sisi kiri
[Chorus]
Permisi, permisi, ayo cepat
Napas kita habis bareng-bareng
Permisi, permisi, besok lagi
Kita telat, tapi nggak sendiri
[Outro - pad and sub bass fade]
Sampai atas, dia sebut namanya
Keretanya pergi, biarin saja
